papers.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks

papers.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
papers.desc: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success.

papers.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
papers.desc: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed.

papers.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.desc: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand.

papers.desc: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces.

papers.title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
papers.desc: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation.

papers.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
papers.desc: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes.

papers.title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
papers.desc: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control.

papers.title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
papers.desc: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them.

papers.title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
papers.desc: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates.

papers.title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
papers.desc: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions.

papers.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
papers.desc: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations.

papers.title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
papers.desc: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings.

papers.title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
papers.desc: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick.

papers.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
papers.desc: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws.
